title: Canto 9: Liberation - Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 9
content:
Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 9

9.1

Title: ‘Shakuntala stops to look back’.

Artist: Raja Ravi Varma

Source: Wikipedia Raja Ravi Varma

9.2

Title: ‘Flashback’.

Artist: © Vlad Holst, used with permission.

Source: Ten dreams.org

9.3

Title: ‘Sukanya en Cyavana muni’.

Artist: Unknown

Source: Internet

9.4

Title: ‘Krishna gives the Sudarshana cakra’.

Artist: Collage of Anand Aadhar of a vintage image in which Shiva hands the Sudarshana cakra to Vishnu with behind it ‘The ten syllables of the kalachakra mantra mandala’.

Source: © Exotic India, exoticindiaart.com (used with permission)

9.5

Title: ‘Shri Vishnu as Lord Sudarshana’.

Artist: Collage of Anand Aadhar combining the image of ‘Shri Vishnu as Lord Sudarshana’ against the background of ‘The ten syllables of the kalachakra mantra mandala’.

Source: Both contemporary art works are © Exotic India, exoticindiaart.com (used with permission)

Title: ‘Gravure représentant un sadhu’.

Artist: Frans Balthazar Solvyns (1760-1824)

Source: CommonsWikimedia.org
